recognize_zh: 骨髓淋巴聚集的免疫染色中，陽性棕色細胞密集於聚集周邊，中央一個淡色圓形區域只含零星陽性細胞，這種「周邊多、中心少」的分布符合 T 細胞標記勾勒出反應性濾泡與其生發中心內的少量 T 細胞。
features: Lymphoid aggregate with strongly membranous-staining cells concentrated at the periphery
Central pale, rounded zone largely negative with only scattered positive cells, consistent with a germinal center
Positive cells are small lymphocytes with crisp membranous staining
Scattered positive cells in the interstitial marrow
Surrounding hematopoietic cells and adipocytes are negative
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a lymphoid aggregate in which positive small lymphocytes are concentrated at the periphery, while a central rounded zone is largely negative with only scattered positive cells. This distribution matches a T-cell marker (such as CD3) outlining a B-cell follicle with a germinal center containing scattered follicular T cells; the specific antibody is not stated. Scattered positive interstitial T cells are also present. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with a germinal center in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: FL follicles also contain scattered T cells, so separation relies on paratrabecular location and BCL2 co-expression by CD10-positive follicle center cells.
NLPHL nodules show T-cell rosettes around large LP cells, not a uniform negative germinal center.
PTCL shows diffuse sheets of atypical T cells with antigen loss rather than a T-cell rim around a preserved follicle.
